dates.what_en: Complaint filed with the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (no. MO-2026-58213)
Employer terminated the employment, without notice
Ministry referred the dispute to court
Claim registered (registry stamp and handwritten note)
Defendant's reply memorandum and documents due

deadlines.what_en: File the reply memorandum with documents, including the original employment contract and the claimant's payslips for January to August 2026

claims.item_en: Unpaid wages: June and July 2026, and 1 to 15 August 2026
Experience certificate; court fees, costs and lawyer's fees

key_facts.fact_en: Monthly salary AED 18,000 in total, of which AED 12,000 basic
The employer stopped paying wages from June 2026
Termination came 11 days after the claimant's complaint to the Ministry, which the claim argues makes it unlawful
The Ministry referred the case to court because the claim exceeds AED 50,000
At the 27 Oct hearing the defendant's lawyer asked for time; the court adjourned and ordered the defendant to produce the original contract and payslips
